title: The Course — 130th Boston Marathon
claims: The page identifies the 130th Boston Marathon presented by Bank of America.
Poland Spring Water and Lemon Lime Gatorade Endurance Formula stations begin at Mile Two.
Three Maurten Hydrogel stations are located at mile 11.8 on the Wellesley town line, at mile 17 in Newton, and at mile 21.5 just after Boston College.
Maurten Gel 100 (non-caffeinated) and Gel 100 CAF 100 (caffeinated) are available at the Maurten stations.
Digital clocks at every 5K mark and key mile locations show unofficial running time from the 9:00 a.m. start only; signage marks miles and 5K points.
There are 26 medical stations along the course; sweep buses pick up runners at every medical station and drop them at the Finish Area medical tent.
Aid stations close at staggered times during the day.
Finish area facilities officially close at approximately 5:30 p.m.
Roads are reopened when officials judge it is time, at approximately a 13:44 minute-per-mile pace; runners still on course are instructed to move to the right side.
Once roads reopen, timing systems, course clocks, medical stations and water stations begin to close; runners still out are on their own.
The B.A.A. fields a team of cyclists at the rear of the pack to assist runners at or slower than 13:44 per mile.
The page links the official 2026 course map PDF at https://www.baa.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/2026-Course-Map.pdf.
